title: CleanSpark Releases June 2026 Operational Update
summary: CleanSpark, Inc. (Nasdaq: CLSK) ("CleanSpark" or the "Company"), a market-leading data center developer, today released its unaudited Bitcoin mining and operations update for the month ended June 30, 2026. "Our bitcoin mining operations continue to perform well in the face of market volatility as we continue to advance our commercialization efforts for Sandersville," said CEO and Chairman Matt Schultz. "We have made meaningful progress towards energization in Texas and look forward to further expanding our HPC campus portfolio in conjunction with monetization."
